asignatura: INICIACIÓN A HABILIDADES COMUNICATIVAS EN INGLÉS(B)
resumen:
Listening in a foreign language is a complex process: main idea, details, predictions, meaning, emotions, opinions (p. 19).
Main skills include listening for main idea, details and specific information, predicting, inferring, identifying emotion, opinions, relationships and context (p. 19-20).
Listening comprehension has pre-, while- and post-listening steps (p. 20-21).
Active listening is a conscious effort to hear the complete message (p. 21).
Five active listening techniques: pay attention, show you're listening, provide feedback, defer judgment, respond appropriately (p. 23-24).

conceptos.definicion: Active Listening is where you make a conscious effort to hear not only the words that another person is saying but, more importantly, the complete message being communicated.
